column1: # Every third-party component a build file pulls in outside pub and Cargo
# (LICENSE-001): where it comes from, its licence as read from its source,
# how it ships, and what the licence was read from. test/js/licence_policy.test.js
# fails on a pull site with no row, a row no build file pulls in, and a licence
# licences.tsv does not allow for how the component ships.
#   linked   compiled or linked into the app, or shipped beside it as a program
#   shared   a separately shipped shared library the user can replace
#   build    a build tool; nothing of it ships
